purpose: Label-free OpenAlex corpus expansion and robustness audit after the Issue #64 Topic freeze; this artifact is not a Topic selection or retrieval evaluation artifact.

split_reference.usage: identity binding only; acquisition and audit must not branch on Dev/Hidden membership

acquisition_policy.deduplication: exact normalized OpenAlex Work ID only
acquisition_policy.api_key_source: OPENALEX_API_KEY environment only; never dotenv or artifact

audit_policy.representative_work_policy: highest query-support count, then cited_by_count, publication_year, and OpenAlex Work ID; descriptive only
audit_policy.topic_amendment_policy: record potential_topic_amendment only; never mutate the frozen Topic Set or split
